With Update 1.3.0, the long-awaited activatable virtual right-side mirror requested by the community is being added to the game. This means you won’t miss potential obstacles on the right side anymore, helping you achieve even better evaluations.
We have extensively reworked the game world, focusing on vegetation and detail to create more realistic landscapes and an even more immersive atmosphere.
All trucks now feature a top-down camera, providing a better overview and making manoeuvring easier. Optimized loading and reloading of the game world also ensures shorter loading times.
The trucks have also received improved gear-shifting behavior, resulting in more efficient and realistic driving.

For a more immersive gaming experience, haptic feedback has been enhanced. The optimized controller vibration and refined steering wheel force feedback provide a much more realistic response when driving over curbs or colliding with obstacles.
For breathtaking screenshots, we’ve significantly increased the draw distance both in-game and in photo mode (16 km!).
In addition, you can expect various gameplay improvements and several bug fixes that further enhance the overall gameplay experience.

releases.displayName: First look at the On The Road "Graphics Update"!

items.text: Hello dear On The Road community.

We are happy to finally give you a first look at the On The Road "Graphics Update" we are currently working on! As you can see, we have given the graphics of On The Road a major overhaul. We are working hard on the update so that you can experience the graphical improvements on your PC, PS5 or Xbox Series X|S as soon as possible. Of course, we'll keep you up to date and share more insights in the future! 🚛
• Fixed the bug when rearranging the load where it was unintentionally deleted, counted as delivered and immediately paid for
• Speed of AI employees, which caused them to complete their routes far too quickly, has been corrected
• Fixed the bug in connection with receiving an email with a contractual penalty, although the order was cancelled without loading and there is no penalty in this context
• Fixed the bug in the sound output of Scania vehicles in connection with accelerating with the parking brake applied or reversing
• Corrected the city names on the world map from Munich and Nuremberg to Munich and Nuremberg for English language selection
• Reduction of memory usage
• Optimization of the processor load
Finally!
We are happy to finally be able to release the biggest and most comprehensive ON THE ROAD update to date as well as a brand new trailer!

In addition to highlights such as the tankers, tank trailers with matching refuelling systems and parking slots for trailers, including an overview in the company headquarters menu, the update also includes a wide range of other features and improvements.
